ideas.title: Jensen Huang resigns as NVIDIA CEO with immediate effect; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO
ideas.hook: 33 years NVIDIA ని నడిపిన Jensen Huang ఒక్కసారిగా ఎందుకు దిగిపోయారు? AI boom కి దీని అర్థం ఏంటి?
points: Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately. NVIDIA's release cites his 33 years of leadership.
CFO Colette Kress, who joined NVIDIA in September 2013, is interim CEO and keeps her finance role. The board is searching for a permanent CEO, internal or external.
Harvey C. Jones, the former Synopsys CEO, is named NVIDIA's first-ever Board Chair.
Q3 fiscal 2027 results are due on 2026-11-17. CNBC reports that NVIDIA's $500B+ financing pact with Apollo, BlackRock and others has produced no deals so far.

ideas.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cheap, fast 'daily driver' model for agentic coding and everyday tasks
ideas.hook: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: తక్కువ price, 2.5x speed, coding test లో 18% నుంచి 57% కి jump. ఇంత cheap AI ఇంత powerful ఎలా?
points: Price is $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, flat across the full 1M-token context window.
Google says it scores 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1, against 18.2% for Gemini 3.8 Flash. It also finishes tasks about 2.5x faster at the default 'high' thinking setting.
Google claims 5x fewer fabricated claims than 3.8 Flash. It ranks only #5 on Agent Arena (MarkTechPost). The benchmark figures are Google's own.
It is rolling out in the Gemini API, AI Studio, the Gemini app and Search.

ideas.title: ElevenLabs launches Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live speech-to-text across 102 languages, with Hindi gains and an India data region
ideas.hook: మనం మాట్లాడేది AI ఎంత correct గా రాయగలదు? 102 languages, Hindi లో 36% better: ElevenLabs Scribe v3 కథ
points: Scribe v3 makes 27% fewer word errors than Scribe v2 across 102 languages. Another report puts overall WER at 12.4%, against 17.0% for v2 and 18.5% for Gemini 3.5 Transcribe.
Scribe v3 Live is the first realtime model from ElevenLabs with speaker labelling. Hindi improves 36% over Scribe v2 Realtime.
In ElevenLabs' earlier figures, Tamil errors fell 29% on the batch model.
Isolated India, EU and Singapore environments are available for enterprise customers. The benchmarks are all ElevenLabs' own.
